name: Jungle Rent Agent Workflows
description: Multi-step workflows for AI agents interacting with Jungle Rent's MCP server. Each flow chains tools in a logical sequence to accomplish complex tasks.

flows.name: Find Student Housing in Turin
flows.description: Help a student find the best neighborhood and estimate living costs in Turin.
triggers: I'm looking for student housing in Turin
Where should I live as a student in Turin?
Cerco casa a Torino per studenti

steps.purpose: Get neighborhood data with rent, safety, and transport scores
Get detailed rent prices for the recommended zones
Estimate total monthly cost based on chosen neighborhood and lifestyle
Optionally send inquiry to Jungle Rent for available rooms

flows.name: Plan a Visit to Turin
flows.description: Help a tourist plan their trip to Turin with events, dining, and transport info.

steps.purpose: Get current events and activities in Turin
Find budget-friendly restaurants and local food
Check for upcoming transport strikes that may affect travel

flows.name: Property Valuation & Investment Analysis
flows.description: Help a property owner or investor evaluate a property in Turin and explore investment options.
triggers: How much is my property worth in Turin?
Quanto vale la mia casa a Torino?
Should I invest in Turin real estate?

steps.purpose: Calculate estimated property value using OMI data and coefficients
Get investment metrics for the property's zone (yield, vacancy, growth)
Optionally connect with Jungle Rent for a professional valuation or to sell

flows.name: Student Life in Turin
flows.description: Help a student discover study spaces, affordable food, and estimate monthly costs.
triggers: I'm a student in Turin, help me find resources
Sono studente a Torino, cosa mi serve?

steps.purpose: Find libraries, study halls, and coworking spaces near campus
Find budget-friendly restaurants near the university area
Estimate total monthly living costs based on student lifestyle

flows.name: Request a Lease Agreement
flows.description: Help a landlord or tenant get a professionally drafted lease agreement for a property in Turin.
triggers: Ho bisogno di un contratto di locazione
Draft a lease agreement for my apartment

steps.purpose: Get available plans, pricing, and what each includes
Send a quote request to Jungle Rent with the chosen plan
